recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片可見單葉或核分離的小型發育不良巨核細胞（dysplastic megakaryocytes），切片以脂肪為主呈低細胞性；核型圖只有一條第 7 號染色體（箭頭），FISH 也呈 7 號單倍體訊號，在兒童合併疣與淋巴水腫時要想到 GATA2 缺乏症（Emberger syndrome）。
features: Aspirate: dysplastic megakaryocytes including a hypolobated/monolobated form and a small megakaryocyte with two widely separated round nuclei
Cluster of megakaryocytes with hypolobated, eccentric nuclei within a particle (image slightly out of focus)
Core biopsy: hypocellular marrow with predominance of adipocytes and scattered small hematopoietic islands
Karyotype: single chromosome 7 (arrow) indicating monosomy 7 in a male karyogram
Interphase FISH with D7S486 (7q31)/CEP7 probes showing a single-copy signal pattern consistent with monosomy 7
describe_en: The bone marrow aspirate shows dysmegakaryopoiesis, with small hypolobated/monolobated megakaryocytes and megakaryocytes with separated round nuclei; blasts are not increased in the fields shown. The core biopsy is hypocellular for age, composed predominantly of adipose tissue with scattered small hematopoietic islands. The G-banded karyogram shows loss of one chromosome 7 (arrow), and interphase FISH with the D7S486/CEP7 probe set shows a single-signal pattern supportive of monosomy 7, although signals are small at this magnification. In a child with warts and lymphedema, findings are consistent with hypocellular myelodysplastic syndrome with monosomy 7 arising in germline GATA2 deficiency (Emberger syndrome).

ddx.vs: Also hypocellular, but lacks dysplastic megakaryocytes and clonal cytogenetic abnormalities such as monosomy 7.
Morphology may be identical, so germline GATA2 sequencing and the clinical triad of warts, lymphedema and monocytopenia/B/NK lymphopenia separate the syndromic form.
Also a germline predisposition with childhood monosomy 7 and hypocellular marrow, distinguished only by germline genetic testing and associated clinical features.
Hypocellular marrow with dysplasia in children, but characterized by chromosome breakage on DEB/MMC testing and congenital anomalies rather than GATA2 mutation.

captions: Aspirate: dysplastic megakaryocytes, monolobated (left) and with separated nuclei (right)
Aspirate: cluster of hypolobated megakaryocytes within a particle
Core biopsy: hypocellular marrow with predominance of fat
Interphase FISH D7S486/CEP7: single-copy signal pattern consistent with monosomy 7
